API ReferenceZIdentity APIAPI ClientsApiclient Ops Get Secrets
Apiclient Ops Get Secrets
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/api-clients/:id/secrets

Retrieves a list of secrets associated with a specific API client using its ID.

NOTE:

Secret values in the response are masked to prevent exposure of sensitive information.
This API is applicable only when the authentication type is SECRET.
Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

The API client ID to retrieve the client secrets.

Responses
​
200
401

The request was successful, and a list of secrets is returned.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier for the client secret.

createdAt
int64
REQUIRED

Timestamp when the secret was created.

value
string
REQUIRED

The secret value.

]
